# Fonts

`sg-fonts/`: pixel fonts by SpicyGame, https://spicygame.itch.io/fonts, licensed CC0 (public
domain). The port offers five of them as English fonts (F1 menu, Game, English font):
Royalty Mono, Quest Square, Pixel Sans, Retro Sans, Rune Mono. `tools/text/gen_fonts.py` draws them
in the game's style into `port/text/en_fonts.h`.
